title: ExerciseSpec
description: Structural contract for a single exercise definition. An exercise is data, not code: every concrete id, name, and alias lives in the JSON documents this schema validates, never in TypeScript source.

id.description: Stable identifier for the exercise (data-only; never referenced in TypeScript).

version.description: Spec version; a mismatch with stored calibration invalidates that calibration.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the exercise grid.

facets.description: Filterable classification facets for the exercise grid.

mode.description: reps: counted repetitions. hold: timed isometric hold.

bilateral.description: Whether the movement is bilateral (left/right symmetric).

landmarkPairs.description: Maps an unprefixed joint name to its left/right landmark indices for bilateral-midpoint resolution.

requiredLandmarks.description: Landmark indices that must be confidently present; every expression landmark must appear here.

optionalLandmarks.description: Landmark indices used when available but not required.

camera.description: Preferred camera framing for this exercise.

signal.description: The scalar signal expression and its smoothing configuration.

expr.description: Signal expression in the evaluator grammar, e.g. angle(hip,knee,ankle).

type.description: Smoothing filter name; an unknown filter fails the build.

states.description: The named phases of the movement.

initial.description: The starting phase; must appear in states.

hysteresisPct.description: Fraction of observed range a signal must cross past a boundary (semantic validator enforces >= 0.05).

minPhaseDurationMs.description: Minimum time a phase must be active before a transition is accepted (semantic validator enforces >= 250).

transitions.description: Guarded transitions evaluated in declaration order; for reps mode exactly one emits RepCompleted.

when.description: Guard expression in the evaluator grammar.

emits.description: Optional domain event emitted on this transition.

velocity.description: Optional relative-velocity tracking configuration. Only relative velocity loss is ever reported; no absolute units.

trackedPoint.description: Expression naming the point to track, e.g. midpoint(left_hip,right_hip).

faults.description: Phase-scoped fault rules; the engine emits every detected fault without cue rationing.

phase.description: The phase this fault is evaluated within; must exist in phases.states.

when.description: Guard expression; UNAVAILABLE suppresses the fault.

cue.description: Movement-focused cue (semantic validator enforces <= 4 words and banned-word-free).
